transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess they brought me in because of what's been happening at work. I work at a warehouse, and... I just keep doing things. Like, I'll just freeze with my arms up right by the forklift, or I'll start copying the beeping sounds and the hand signals the drivers make. 

And sometimes I move the boxes around in these strange little patterns... and I keep doing it even when everyone is yelling for me to stop. So, yeah, they wanted me to come see you.
When did you first start experiencing these episodes of freezing, copying movements, and arranging the boxes?
I think... it's been about six months now. The strange behavior at the warehouse, and I guess my talking has been confusing people too... all of that has been happening for about six months.
During these past six months, have you been experiencing persistent feelings of depression or sadness?
No, not really. I haven't felt sad or depressed. I mean, I don't feel down or anything like that. It's really just the stuff at work that I told you about... but no, I haven't noticed feeling sad.
Have you had periods where you felt unusually energetic, hyper, or like you didn't need to sleep?

No, I haven't really had anything like that. I sleep fine, mostly. I don't get super hyper or have tons of energy. I just go to work and... well, then the stuff happens that I told you about. But no, I haven't felt unusually energetic or anything.
Have you been diagnosed with any physical illnesses or medical conditions?

No, I haven't. Um, physically I'm fine. I don't have any medical conditions or anything like that. I mean, my body works fine for the warehouse and all... I've never been told I have any physical illnesses.
